itemList.description: Loosening, leveling and compacting original ground supporting embankment to facilitate placemetn of first layer of embankment scarified to a depth of 150mm, mixed with water at OMC and then compacted by rolling so as to achieve minimum dry density as given in table 300-2 for embankment construction

Construction of embankment by excavating the available approved grave/murrum deposited at a place or borrow pits during or prior excavation with all lifts and lead transportation to site spreading grading to required slopw and compacting to meet the requirement complete as per specification including cost of labour rolling water all material usage & all other appurtenaces required to complete as the work.

Providing, laying, spreading and compacting graded stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory roller to achieve the desired density.

Providing and constructing un-reinforced plain cement concrete pavement thickness as per design over a prepared sub base with 43 grade cement or any other type as per clause 1501.2.2 M20 grade coarse and of coarse aggregates conforming to IS:383, maximum size of coarse aggregate not exceeding 25mm, mixed in a concrete mixer of not less than 0.2 m3 capacity and appropriate weigh batcher using approved mix design laid in approved fixed side formwork steel channel, laying and fixing of 125 micron thick polythene film wedges steel plates including leveling the formwork as per drawing) spreading the concrete with shovels rakes compacted using needle screed and plate vibrators and finished in continuous operation including construction joints, primer sealent curing of concrete slabs for 14- days and water finishing to lines and grade as per drawin and technical specification clause 1501 with all lead lifts loading unloading charges cost and conveyance of all materials labour equipment etc., complete as per the directions of the engineer in charges of the work
